newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai police seize 15.4 kg of heroin, hold five.
newsitem.headline: Thai police seize 15.4 kg of heroin, hold five.

text.p: Thai police said on Wednesday they arrested five suspected drug traffickers and seized 15.4 kg (34.04 lb) of heroin hours before the men planned to ship the drug, concealed in pottery, to Australia.

The arrests on Tuesday came after more than three months of investigations and the confiscation of 150 pieces of pottery lined with heroin, the chief of the anti-narcotics police, Lieutenant General Nophadol Somboonsap, told reporters.
Two of the five arrested were from China while the rest were ethnic Chinese Thais, he added.
"They planned to ship the heroin to a Pacific Island and later to Australia but we were able to catch them just hours before the pottery was put on board a ship," he said.
The suspects were detained and would be charged formally later with heroin trafficking.
Convicted drug traffickers face the death penalty in Thailand, but traditionally such sentences are commuted to a long jail term.
